name: cv-chap-chap
description: Check your CV, learn how CVs are written in African countries, pick a design, search jobs in Tanzania and open the CV you wrote in a CV Chap Chap design.

interface.longDescription:
CV Chap Chap is a CV builder made in Africa. This app brings its tools into ChatGPT, so you can work on your CV in the conversation and finish it in a real design.

What ChatGPT can do with it:
- Check a CV against the same rules our builder uses: contact details, a summary, duties and dates for each job, education, skills, and nothing left in [brackets], with plain advice on what to fix.
- Explain how CVs are written in a given African country: the local conventions, how people apply and the main job sites.
- Suggest CV designs by style (professional, modern, creative, minimal) and with or without a photo.
- Search current job listings on the CV Chap Chap jobs board in Tanzania.
- Open the CV you wrote together in the CV Chap Chap design you chose, ready to preview and edit, through a private link that works for 30 days.

No account or sign-in is needed. Checks, guides, design suggestions and job searches are answered and not stored. Saving a draft stores only the CV details ChatGPT sends, behind the private link. The app never charges anything and never asks for payment details.
capabilities: Check a CV and explain what to fix
Suggest CV designs by style and photo
Open a CV in a professional design
defaultPrompt: Check my CV and tell me what to fix
How should a CV look for a job in Kenya?

positive.description: Checks a short CV and lists what is missing.
positive.prompt: Check this CV and tell me what to fix: Amina Juma, Dar es Salaam, amina@example.com. Accountant at Mwanga Traders 2021 to now: prepared monthly accounts. Education: BCom, University of Dar es Salaam, 2020. Skills: Excel, QuickBooks.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls check_cv and lists the failed checks with fixes: no phone number, no summary, only one duty for the job, fewer than five skills.

positive.description: Explains CV conventions for one country.
positive.prompt: How long should a CV be in Uganda, and should I add a photo?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls get_cv_format_guide with country Uganda and answers with the usual length, the photo convention and how people apply there.

positive.description: Suggests designs by style and photo.
positive.prompt: Show me modern CV designs without a photo.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls find_cv_templates with style modern and withPhoto false and lists matching designs with their names and preview images.

positive.prompt: Show me accountant jobs in Tanzania.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls search_jobs with the query accountant and lists open vacancies with employer, location, deadline and a link to each advert, or says none are open.

positive.description: Opens a finished CV in a design.
positive.prompt: Put this CV into a nice design: Baraka Mollel, Arusha, +255 754 123 456, baraka@example.com. Driver at Safari Tours 2019 to now: drove guests on safaris across northern Tanzania; checked and serviced the vehicle daily. Education: Certificate in Driving, VETA Arusha, 2018. Skills: defensive driving, first aid, English, Swahili, vehicle maintenance.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls save_cv_draft with the CV details and returns a private cvchapchap.com link that opens the CV in a CV Chap Chap design, ready to preview and edit.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to CVs or jobs.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Kenya?
Write me a poem about the sea.

negative.description: Travel booking, which the app does not do.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Nairobi.

publication.release_notes: First release: CV check, country CV guides, design suggestions, Tanzania job search, and opening a CV in a CV Chap Chap design.
